chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about stagnant water in which there is a carcass.
He said: “Wudu (ablution) is performed from the other side, and wudu (ablution) is not performed from the side of the carcass.”

key_terms.الْجَانِبِ الْآخَرِ: the other side away from the impurity
key_terms.الْجِيفَةُ: a carcass or dead animal in the water
key_terms.جَانِبِ الْجِيفَةِ: the side where the carcass is present

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on performing wudu (ablution) from stagnant water that contains a carcass?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the use of stagnant water when a carcass is present in it. It indicates avoiding the side of the water affected by the carcass and taking wudu (ablution) from the other side.
